content.comment_body: Hi, All [product_name] devices come with the default password "LOGO". Yesterday, I tried to check my device, but entering the password online via IP address showed it as incorrect. I can't remember what the correct password is or if someone changed it. Can someone advise what I should do next?
Hello, You may find the following resource useful: [url] Do you have the original [product_name] software in case you want to download it again after removing your program?
Thanks for the response. I don't need the software, I can just delete it.
You can reset the password back to the default "LOGO" by accessing the settings in your [product_name] device. Please share how it worked out for you.

There are separate passwords for various functions in the [product_name] [article_no] version. The default is "LOGO" for all functions. If you don't remember the password protecting the program, you can only delete both the program and the password, then set a new one. For switching from operator mode to ADMIN mode, you can use the software and access control to assign a new password easily. Could you clarify for which function you need the password?
Hi [user_name], Yes, the default password is "LOGO". If it's not working, the only option is to use the attached PNG to clear both the program and password.
I had the same issue and resolved it by opening the access control tab in the settings and clearing the password.
Password protection for the program and for access control are distinct features.
A new question by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled "Clear password [product_name] v.8". Best regards, [user_name]
A new question from [user_name] has been split into another topic called "How to set password in [product_name] 8.fs4". Best regards, [user_name]

First review the red adapter in [product_name] software (look for the red rectangle in the image). Reset the password on the [product_name] device, then power it off for one minute and turn it back on. Your program should be ready to download.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulties with password management on [product_name] devices, particularly when default passwords are forgotten or have been changed. There is confusion between different password types (program vs. access control), and solutions usually require deleting programs or resetting passwords, which may cause loss of data or extra effort.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for a straightforward method to recover or reset forgotten passwords without losing existing programs or settings. They also expect clear guidance regarding the different password functionalities for these devices.
